A Great Experience at Restaurant Treat
Dec 2024 • Couples
Recently I had the pleasure of dining at Treat restaurant at the Oakwood Hotel Hanoi, and I was really impressed by the excellent service. What made our evening special was not only the delicious food, but above all the caring and attentive service of the staff, especially from Đức Hải, Tiến, Amy and Luly.

Đức Hải made us feel comfortable all the time and made sure all our wishes were fulfilled quickly. Tiến was always cheerful and gave great recommendations for the menu, which made us feel very comfortable. Amy and Luly also contributed to a great experience with their warm and friendly approach. Amy created a cosy atmosphere with her gentle communication, while Luly had an eye for every little detail so we always had exactly what we needed.

The restaurant has a cosy and pleasant atmosphere, but it was mainly the sincere and caring staff who really made our evening special. I want to thank Đức Hải, Tiến, Amy and Luly for making our experience memorable. Your service was not only professional but also so friendly, which made us feel truly appreciated.

If you are looking for a restaurant with great food and excellent service, Treat is the ideal choice. I look forward to returning, knowing we are in such good hands.

Above all, great experience
Dec 2024 • Family
I just had a great dinner at TrEat Restaurant, Oakwood Residence Hanoi Hotel. Not only were we impressed by the luxurious space, the delicious food and the delicate presentation, but we are also very satisfied with the professional service provided by Duchay.

Hai was very caring for me and my family, always kind and passionate. Hai's dedication and passion for the work is revealed through how to advise for appropriate cooking, agile service, always up to the attention to the customer experience in every small detail.

I really believe that staff like Hai are the pride of hotels and restaurants. I sincerely praise Duchay and wish you more and more success in your career. TrEat restaurant always hope to maintain such excellent service quality.
